description: We are Koyllur Dynamics, a team from UNSA in Arequipa, Peru, led by Dr. Juan Carlos Cutipa Luque and Mechanical and Electronics Engineering students. We combine robotics, design, control, and NASA data to create Rover-Time, an interactive lunar mission simulator for NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. Our goal is to inspire young learners to explore STEM, collaborate, and help build Peru’s future in space.
